title: List Event Types
description: Returns the list of all available event types. Some documented event types may not be returned if your Fullstory plan does not support them. If a returned event definition indicates that it has subcategories, that means that you must supply a subcategory when creating an endpoint that receives that type of event. You can get the list of available subcategories via the [List Event Subcategories](../list-event-subcategories) API.

display_name.description: A user-friendly display name for this kind of event.

has_subcategories.description: True if this kind of event has subcategories.

event_defs.description: The list of event type definitions, up to the requested limit.
